title: Can we live without plastic?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which single-use plastic item would be easiest for society to eliminate completely?
Where are plastic alternatives genuinely better, and where can they create other environmental problems?
Should consumers pay extra for plastic packaging, or should producers pay?
Can recycling solve plastic pollution, or does society need to reduce production itself?
What plastic item in your daily life would be hardest to replace?
